description: This file defines the ThemeHandlerInterface interface in Drupal, which manages the list of available themes including listing, adding, refreshing, resetting, and retrieving theme information.

methods.name: listInfo
methods.description: Returns a list of currently installed themes with detailed properties.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Adds a theme extension to the internal listing.

methods.name: refreshInfo
methods.description: Refreshes the theme info data of currently installed themes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the theme handler.

methods.name: rebuildThemeData
methods.description: Scans and collects theme extension data and their engines; deprecated in newer Drupal versions.

methods.name: getBaseThemes
methods.description: Finds all the base themes for a specified theme; deprecated in newer Drupal versions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the human-readable name of a given theme.

methods.name: getThemeDirectories
methods.description: Returns an array of directories for all installed themes.

methods.name: themeExists
methods.description: Checks if a given theme is installed.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Returns a theme extension object for a given theme name.

methods.name: hasUi
methods.description: Determines if a theme should be shown in the user interface.
